import pytest
from string_utils import mask_email

def test_mask_email_single_char_local():
    """Test single-character local part (no masking needed)."""
    assert mask_email("a@example.com") == "a@example.com"

def test_mask_email_long_local():
    """Test long local part (mask all but first char)."""
    assert mask_email("jsmith@example.com") == "j*****@example.com"

def test_mask_email_empty_local():
    """Test empty local part (should raise ValueError)."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="invalid email: empty local part or domain"):
        mask_email("@example.com")

def test_mask_email_empty_domain():
    """Test empty domain (should raise ValueError)."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="invalid email: empty local part or domain"):
        mask_email("user@")

def test_mask_email_no_at():
    """Test missing '@' (should raise ValueError)."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="invalid email: missing '@'"):
        mask_email("userexample.com")

import pytest
from containers import flatten

def test_max_depth_8_with_empty_nested_lists():
    """Test empty nested lists are flattened correctly."""
    nested = [1, [], [2, [], [3]]]
    result = flatten(nested)
    assert result == [1, 2, 3]

def test_max_depth_1_with_empty_nested_lists():
    """Test max_depth=1 with empty nested lists raises ValueError on nesting."""
    nested = [1, []]
    result = flatten(nested, max_depth=1)
    assert result == [1]  # Empty list should not cause nesting error

def test_max_depth_8_with_mixed_empty_and_non_empty():
    """Test mixed empty and non-empty nested structures."""
    nested = [1, [2, [], [3, [4, []]]]]
    result = flatten(nested)
    assert result == [1, 2, 3, 4]

def test_max_depth_8_with_negative_max_depth():
    """Test negative max_depth raises ValueError."""
    nested = [1, [2]]
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="nesting too deep"):
        flatten(nested, max_depth=-1)

def test_max_depth_8_with_zero_max_depth():
    """Test zero max_depth raises ValueError on any nesting."""
    nested = [1, [2]]
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="nesting too deep"):
        flatten(nested, max_depth=0)

import pytest
from containers import flatten


def test_flatten_string_atomic():
    """Test that strings are treated as atomic (not flattened)."""
    result = flatten(["hello", [1, 2], "world"])
    assert result == ["hello", 1, 2, "world"]


def test_flatten_tuple_nested():
    """Test that tuples are flattened like lists."""
    result = flatten([1, (2, 3), 4])
    assert result == [1, 2, 3, 4]


def test_flatten_max_depth_one_with_tuple():
    """Test that max_depth=1 stops at first level, even for tuples."""
    result = flatten([(1, 2), (3, 4)], max_depth=1)
    assert result == [1, 2, 3, 4]


def test_flatten_max_depth_8_default():
    """Test that default max_depth=8 works for deep nesting."""
    result = flatten([1, [2, [3, [4, [5, [6, [7, [8]]]]]]]], max_depth=8)
    assert result == [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]
